thread:
anya: Heads-up  planning session notes: we need a crisp roadmap for private deployments focused on upgrade ergonomics + customer-managed networking. Customer asks are converging: simpler upgrades, clear rollback, and ability to keep their egress IPs.
sam: We should prioritize three deliverables for Q3: (1) zero-touch upgrade flow (in-place), (2) egress-preserve operator, (3) KMS selection path + docs.
maria: Field intel: 2 enterprise customers need HSM/KMS within launch or they won't sign. Also one wants client cert rotation support.
jon: For zero-touch upgrades, proposal: controller runs node drainless upgrade with version pinning + health probes. If probe fails, automatic rollback. Need canary policy.
oscar: Networking constraint: many customers sit behind NAT/proxies. Egress-preserve operator can't assume global control. Need fallback relay and clear perf numbers.
anya: Proposed acceptance criteria (must meet all):
- Upgrade success rate >=98% (internal test harness)
- Customer in-place rollback <10 minutes for 95% cases
- Egress IP preserved in 90% NAT-less installs; relay fallback documented otherwise
- KMS integration path documented, sample config + operator flags
maria: Launch lanes idea:
- Lane A (low-friction): operator + docs, for customers that allow daemonsets
- Lane B (proxy/NAT): operator + relay image, with perf warning
- Lane C (regulated): on-prem bundle + offline installer + KMS/HSM support
jon: Test matrix we need to cover ASAP:
- single-node onprem airgapped
- multi-node VPC private subnets (NATed egress)
- peered datacenter w/ preserved egress
- regulated airgap w/ HSM
oscar: Metrics to collect during canary: install time, upgrade delta, rollback time, token latency p95/p99 change, CPU/GPU host overhead. Keep lightweight telemetry.
sam: UX notes: installer should surface a preflight checklist. Minimal preflight items: available disk, outbound connectivity test, KMS handshake test. Preflight script idea:
```
# preflight.sh (simple)
curl -sf https://redwood-status.local/ok || echo "connectivity-fail"
openssl s_client -connect kms.example.com:443 -brief || echo "kms-fail"
```
anya: Dependencies & owners:
- operator code (sam)
- upgrade controller + probes (maria)
- relay + perf tests (oscar)
- installer/offline packaging (anya)
- docs + customer runbook (jon)
- telemetry small payload (eng-infra volunteer)
jon: Risk log quick hits:
- Relay adds latency for token calls; could break SLAs. Mitigation: rate-limit, local cache.
- HSM integrations vary per vendor; provide generic KMS shim + vendor-specific guides.
- Airgapped installs often fail due to missing CA bundles. Add explicit CA import step in installer.
oscar: Customer communication plan: staged emails to current POCs, include opt-in canary sign-up form + expected maintenance windows.
maria: Timeline proposal: 2-week spike (prove operator can preserve egress in lab); 3-week sprint (implement upgrade controller + preflight); 2-week canary run with 3 customers; GA after metrics validated.
anya: Need product signoff on acceptance criteria + owners by EOD Monday. @sam @maria @oscar please ack.
ops-bot: Note: maintenance window calendar slot reserved: 2024-09-02 01:00-04:00 UTC.
sam: Ack. I'll own operator prototype PR by mid-week.
maria: Ack. I'll own upgrade controller and probes.
oscar: Ack. Relay perf harness next sprint.
jon: I'll draft customer runbook + preflight guide and post to docs channel.
anya: Thanks team. I'll consolidate this thread into the roadmap doc and attach the canary signup sheet.
